---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_hr = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID)
  ) |>
  slice_max(career_hr, n = 15) |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(
    player = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    steroid_era = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Active in 1994–2009",
      "Outside 1994–2009"
    ),
    player = fct_reorder(player, career_hr)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = career_hr, y = player, fill = steroid_era)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Active in 1994–2009" = "#e15759",
      "Outside 1994–2009" = "#4e79a7"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "MLB All-Time Career Home Run Leaders",
    subtitle = "Over half of the top 15 sluggers played during the 1994–2009 steroid era",
    x = "Career Home Runs",
    y = "Player",
    fill = "Era",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(hr = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#e15759") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds Home Runs by Season (1986–2007)",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```
